cohort: A 27-year-old Bahraini female, pregnant for the first time, diagnosed with severe aplastic anemia.
finding: This case report details the clinical course and management of severe aplastic anemia presenting during pregnancy, leading to preterm cesarean section and persistent pancytopenia postpartum.
mod_finding: The pregnancy was terminated by cesarean section at 29 weeks of gestation, with the patient remaining stable during and after surgery.
